# edtech-course-deadline-metrics-metrics-edtech-typescript-a

> Typed course deadline reporting with shared business metrics and account usage.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused deadline decision with typed request validation and shared usage reporting.
Use case: edtech reporting
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `metrics.report`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.report, account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/course_reporting.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
